rationale: Both independently caught the same latent bug (ARDiffusionModelRunner.execute_model missing the diffusion_kv_metadata param) with strong evidence, and both are well-grounded and actionable with concrete file/line citations. Y edges out on recall: its proposed DTO-local invariants (__post_init__ uniqueness/referential checks) closely mirror asukaqaq-s's ground-truth ask for 'local construction-time invariants' (non-empty IDs, unique branch IDs, valid enums), and its call to collapse the two overlapping identity-validation paths echoes the ground truth's redundant-validation-layers complaint. X contributes a solid unique catch (DLO+AllGather fallback silently dropping DP concurrency when metadata is present) but its report trails off into truncated 'additional observations' and skips the validation-consolidation theme that dominates the human review.
